title: Birds
description:
Birds is an Fast Paced, Online PVP Vehicle Combat Game. Fly a Jet for the country, Outmaneuver enemy Jets, Use the bomb to Destroy Enemy Ships. 

Fly Solo or with a Team. Pick up the Bomb and drop it onto the Enemy Ship to destroy the opponent spawn. 

FLYTake Off from your ship and lift up your landing gear to gain complete movement!

DOGFIGHTDodge, Duck. Dip, Dive, and Dodge enemy bullets

DESTROY THE ENEMY SHIPEscort the bomb and Destroy the Enemy Ship!

TOKENS/CURRENCYEarn tokens in match which can be wagered against other players

Regular Matches: Winning team earns a token

Wager Matches: Winning team earns what they wager

GAMEMODESRegular TDM Matches

Wager Matches [1, 5, 10, 25 Token Wagers]; Play Online Solo

 Practice Mode

Dev Note: Play against a friend to see who's worse
description_short: Fly For Your Flag. Outmaneuver Opposing Jets, Get The Bomb and Drop it onto the Enemy Ship. Protect your ship & Destroy the enemy before it's too late.
